#!/bin/bash
# jz-skills pre-commit hook — pdf source 自洽门（blocker#3 机器强制触发）
# 安装: bash deploy/hooks/install.sh   （或手动 ln -s ../../deploy/hooks/pre-commit .git/hooks/pre-commit）
# 绕过: git commit --no-verify
#
# 仅当本次提交涉及 shared/2pdf/ 时触发；只跑 --source-only（不要求 canonical 已部署）。
set -uo pipefail
REPO_ROOT="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)"
if git diff --cached --name-only | grep -q '^shared/2pdf/'; then
  echo "[pre-commit] shared/2pdf 改动 → 跑 pdf-drift-gate --source-only"
  bash "$REPO_ROOT/deploy/2pdf-drift-gate.sh" --source-only || {
    echo "[pre-commit] ❌ pdf source 自洽门未通过，提交已阻止（绕过: git commit --no-verify）"
    exit 1
  }
fi
exit 0
